ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within a grid composed of small squares with side length 1, there is a circle $\odot O$ with radius 1 centered on a grid point. What is the value of the tangent of $\angle AED$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} According to the inscribed angle theorem, we have $\angle AED = \angle ABC$, thus $\tan\angle AED = \tan\angle ABC = \frac{AC}{AB} = \boxed{\frac{1}{2}}$.
